verdict.rationale: The Instinct docs cover cluster-scale operation: end-to-end AI cluster validation, a Kubernetes GPU Operator and device plugin, a Slurm-compatible scheduler, cluster-wide utilization profiling, and cloud deployment on Azure. ROCm also ships communication primitives and serving recipes for vLLM and SGLang. However, nothing in the pack documents the MI325X's high-bandwidth interconnect (Infinity Fabric link bandwidth or topology) or specific multi-GPU node and rack configurations; the arch-spec row lists only compute and memory figures. Missing for 10: documented Infinity Fabric/interconnect bandwidth and topology, multi-GPU platform (e.g. 8-GPU node) specifications, rack-scale reference designs, independent or hands-on corroboration of scale-out training.
